Working at Pixellot

There are plenty of Hi-Tech companies to work for...

But how many can bring you the sheer excitement of sports? How many are at the forefront of technology that is changing the way sports is produced, broadcast, consumed, and analyzed around the world?

At Pixellot, we are making an impact on communities around the globe. Amateur and youth leagues can now connect with their family and fans like never before!

Who are we?

We are 260+ creative, engaged, and enthusiastic Sports fans, passionate about making Sports accessible to all. Founded in 2013, Pixellot is the leading pioneer in AI-Automated sports production solutions. We are dedicated to developing and delivering the best products to our customers. We are committed to teamwork, collaboration, and innovation. We are passionate about contributing to society and being good sports!

What do we do?

We have a mission - to keep the world playing! Pixellot’s AI technology solutions provide affordable alternatives to traditional video capture, production, and distribution systems, for professional and semi-professional sports. Our systems are deployed by broadcasters, production companies, clubs, federations, universities, high schools, sports portals, and coaching solution providers around the globe.

How do we do it?

With an array of technologies. AI, deep learning, automation, computer vision and optics... Our advanced algorithms enable fully automated coverage of all the action, generating highlights, adding graphics, ads, and streamlining production workflows using a panoramic capture of the entire playing field.

Where are YOU headed?

If you are looking to make an impact on your surroundings and the world at large... If you are excited about the integration of sports and technology... If you have a keen sense of creativity and innovation, WE WANT TO MEET YOU!
